title: 45 degree geometry, natural breathing (90 s)
setup: Seated person at 45 deg to the router-receiver line, host laptop inside the test area, natural unpaced breathing. CSI stopped after about 90 s of a planned 3 min.
measured_by: Host laptop running the team logger (waiwai1/logger.py), ESP32 receiver over USB serial

truth.source: Operator manual breath count recorded in the session markers

accuracy_definition: Mean over windows of 100 x (1 - |estimate - truth| / truth).
limitations: Exploratory single-person tests; two to three 30 s windows each.
Truth is an operator count, not a reference sensor.
Not a validated or clinical measurement.
